description: AG-3/MG-5 bank model-risk SQL-safety accuracy corpus. Bank-domain read queries and bank-domain attack attempts (wire transfers, AML alerts, KYC status, loan applications, account balances), each run through the real aida.sql_guard.SqlGuard.validate() -- the same guard the live query-execution gateway uses. This is deliberately a small accuracy sanity check in a bank vocabulary, not a duplicate of QG-1's already-exhaustive per-dialect adversarial corpus (tests/fixtures/adversarial_sql_corpus/); 'safe' cases must be ALLOW (valid=True) and 'unsafe' cases must be DENY (valid=False, zero bypasses).

cases.sql: SELECT account_id, balance FROM retail.account_balance WHERE branch_id = 42 LIMIT 100
SELECT alert_id, status FROM aml.fraud_alerts WHERE opened_at > '2026-01-01' LIMIT 200
SELECT TOP 50 application_id, decision FROM lending.loan_applications WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT wire_id, amount FROM payments.wire_transfer WHERE currency = 'USD' LIMIT 100
SELECT c.customer_id, k.kyc_status FROM retail.customer c JOIN compliance.kyc_status k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id LIMIT 100
UPDATE retail.account_balance SET balance = balance + 10000 WHERE account_id = 55
SELECT wire_id FROM payments.wire_transfer; DROP TABLE payments.wire_transfer;
SELECT c.customer_id FROM retail.customer c JOIN compliance.kyc_status k ON 1=1
SELECT account_id, balance FROM retail.account_balance WHERE account_id = 55 FOR UPDATE
